title: Hinomori Shiho — The Answer I Found〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My chest still feels like it's going to burst...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When we all played together... When Ichika sang, I felt her power, her resolve...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We have a chance to make it as pros...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku helped me get through this too. I should tell her what happened...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What happened, Shii?!
Your eyes are all red...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did you rub them too hard after something got in them? Or could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
H-Hold on!
Don't tell me you're about to cry too?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyways, there's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, of course... But we should get you cleaned up a little first! Stay right there, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My eyes were just a little itchy. She always does this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You didn't need to do that, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyways, can I get back to why I'm here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you already know that I want to become a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I was scared about what would happen to Ichika and the others if they tried to do the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I always wanted us to try together, but it's not like they were all that interested in going pro...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And after I was recruited by someone to play in their band, I did some soul searching.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. So that's why you were acting the way you were...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know that I want to keep playing with them now. They even showed that they're serious about going pro with me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have no idea what's going to happen moving forward, but what they said couldn't have made me happier...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The four of us are gonna give it a shot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I feel bad for making Shizuku worry about me, but now we can...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm the one that put Ichika and everyone else through a lot, but they answered right back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They accepted me for who I am. They understand what I really want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nothing...
Also, how long do you plan on staying here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, I'd like to take a bath before then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we used to take baths together when we were little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. Wait, shouldn't you go rinse your face off first before you go in?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I may want to...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for being there for me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that was nothing. I was just doing what a big sister is supposed to do...
